description: TfL publishes highway-contractor maintenance boundaries under its HMPF arrangements. The source states that HMPF replaced the LoHAC contract on 30 March 2021 and updates occur as required. Polygon metadata includes contractor and area fields plus operational contact descriptors. Only field definitions were inspected; no personal contact values were obtained. The boundaries describe maintenance responsibility and can delimit infrastructure-management scenarios. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
